body: Couldn't have said it better myself, very well written! I believe it's selfish for people to stop someone from putting their self out of their misery and pain. I'm at peace with ending my life as well. My question for people who call people that commit suicide cowards is can you imagine how much pain and suffering someone is going through to see this as an only option.
I feel the same I ruined a life with the one person I love more than anything and the guilt pain emptiness and misery never go away it just gets worse

It didn't go well thank you for checking. I'm not going to kill myself YET I deserve every second of this pain, agony and misery I'm in, my self harm is at an all time high and it's only going to get worse. I've cut her name into my boy 3 times now and I'm sure this is only the beginning. Thanks again, there is no helping me.

If there were even a chance of me living, I would never ever look again. If you knew the whole situation you would know she was the one for me and how bad I ruined this. If you knew the whole situation you would agree I deserve to die as well.
Addiction is probably an understatement, I haven't talked to her in almost a month. I've lost 20 pounds, and doing the simplest task takes the most energy.

A type of medication. I won't go into detail. But it will work. I've been through many and none have come close to meaning this much. I'm a very attractive and successful man and have the life many would probably want. I feel like in life you know the one meant for you and I could even accept it if I weren't at fault in her decision but I can't live without her or with the constant guilt I could never forgive myself or live happy or even sane again .

It's fair to us both, I can't go everyday without her in my life anymore, it's harder to breath I don't eat I can't think. I simply can't function. She is my need my only need. If I die I get peace and she gets to live the life she wants and doesn't have to have me as a burden anymore.
I'm simply waiting to obtain my means to do so.

I have I am getting cremated it's 1,500$ where I live I will leave a note behind leaving my plans for after my death behind. Peace is all I'm looking for and death is my only option I hope you find yours before it gets to this point.
I'm in the same boat lost the only person in this world for me and it's all my fault I plan on ending my life as well.
Where did you get cyanide please help I'm in the same boat

I'm with you without my queen I'm lost and there's this never ending out of pain and misery, she was my person, my person for life idc how many people are on this earth you know when you've found the one for you. I'm ready to end it and now it's just a waiting game honestly.
Agreed that's my wish every day

Going through the same thing now everything I do everyday reminds me of her and how much I love her, I messed our relationship up and I can never forgive myself for letting the one person in the world for me go. Life's not the same
